summary: Our three seats beat u6bkep in 9:13, when his commander died at his base at B4 under teal's and dark blue's groups after both his vehicle plants had fallen (8:56, 9:13); the record runs to 9:24. The opening ran on the constructor-first lists, with three solars and each commander on its plant (assist4 140 s a seat), and we lost one extractor all game. His 11-Blitz ball pushed teal's lone group back at D5 (4:55-5:19, 651 lost for 330). Teal and dark blue then met it together near E5 (5:42-6:01, eight Blitzes for eight of ours), and teal broke his Blitz-Stout-Janus block at C5 alone (7:12-7:40, 1,585 for 960); once his plant was seen at 7:39, both groups went for the base. Purple's group raided the north strip alone and lost ten Incisors to his C4 block and the Beamer at C1 (6:43-7:02). The hands' fall-back then walked it home, and it stood frozen at G1 from 8:05 to the end, so two of three groups killed the base, losing 29 units to his commander's D-gun and death blast.

root.what: None. The game never left the winning path: his commander died at 9:13. their_play: u6bkep (Armada) opened raiding with single Blitzes from 3:09 (F1, F8). Dark blue lost one extractor and a constructor at F8 at 3:48, our only extractor lost all game. By 4:55 he had an 11-Blitz ball in the middle at D5; it pushed teal back and lost eight Blitzes at E5/E6 to two groups together (5:42-6:01). His Blitz-Stout-Janus block held C4-C5 at 6:43-7:57, beside a radar and a Beamer at C1 on the north strip (2 Incisors killed). His base was two vehicle plants at B4 (first seen 7:39), 14 solars and a nano turret, with his commander kept there. It killed 12 of ours with its weapon (8:49-9:10) and 17 with its death blast. We saw no tier 2, no air and no turret but the Beamer. Without a truth file his economy is unknown; we killed seven extractors of his.

bears_on.note: The lesson comes from this game (7:36, 7:50), after purple's raid lost two Incisors to the Beamer at C1. The player answered 'we'll stop running raiders into the beamer', barred spot_4 and won with overwhelming numbers at the plant.
Our army was 4.0-4.9x his seen army at 5:00-6:00 (seat 0's view), and the base and commander were dead by 9:13: about four minutes, near the pool's 3.4-minute median.

The lone groups lost: teal at D5 651 for 330, purple at C4 and C1 1,200 for 820. Two together won at E5 (8 for 8 in units, 880 against 732 in metal). Purple's group sat out the final attack, frozen at home by the hands.
His commander died at B4 to whole-group attacks on its party (8:50 'attack party_31_t3 (1 armcom, 2 armcv, 3 armstump) with the whole group'), at a cost of 12 to its weapon and 17 to its death blast.

Every seat built three solars and then ran a constructor-first list, the intent the lesson gives the third solar. The 1:05 refusal made purple's first unit a soldier (1:13), with the constructor at 1:22 (pool median 1:22).
floor assist4 was 140 s on every seat (thebluegecko's 140 in the skill's O3), and the economy grew to 27 extractors at 6:00 across the seats.
Four converters were built unasked 5:23-5:58, a harness default removed from the menu that night (0f1e6b2).
Our first soldier crossed at 2:42 but held as a scout at spot_2. The first building of his killed was at 5:50, past the pool's p75 of 5:08. That was enough against a 19-rated player in a 3v1.

lens.caveats: There is no truth file, results.jsonl or batch.json, so his numbers are floors. The per-match tools read record-0 only; seats 1 and 2 were read through symlink directories in the scratchpad. pro_baseline found no carded side from G1/B8 as Cortex. The all-starts any-faction pool is a 1v1 pool set against one of three seats, and its pressure rows are blank without truth. Where this row differs from the ledger row (the main session's reading): (1) The ledger has 'his commander alone at B4 ... taken as his resignation'. The records show his commander destroyed at 9:13 at B4, with every unit of his destroyed 9:14-9:16. (2) The ledger says 'hit by all three groups'. Purple's group stood at F1/G1 from 8:05 to the end. (3) The ledger counts '18 Blitzes for 2' at 5:52. The records give 8 for 8. (4) The ledger dates the converters from 5:52; the first one is at 5:23. The chat speaker '?' is attributed to Infern8 after the ledger.

open_questions: Was his commander killed by our fire or self-destructed? The records show its destruction at 9:13:00, with its blast killing 17 of ours in the same frame, but not the cause; the demo would settle it.

What exactly froze purple's group from 8:05: the march rule stopping the strung-out leaders while the body held at the yard (this row's reading of the cmd rows), or something at the yard? The march is deleted, so it bears only on the episode's lesson.
Would three groups at B4 from 8:05 have ended the game sooner, with fewer raiders lost to the commander's weapon?
